i.norm: Verifies that calling clear() on a SummaryStatistics instance whose statistical implementations (sum, max, variance, min, mean) have all been replaced with a shared StorelessGeometricMean resets the observation count to zero.
Replace all five statistical sub-implementations with a single shared StorelessGeometricMean instance, exercising the custom-impl injection path.
After clear(), the count of accumulated observations must be zero regardless of which implementations are registered.
